response.rationale: Both answers are valid for the stated sense. “Paruh waktu” is established Indonesian usage, while “separuh masa” is understandable and attested Malaysian Malay usage for part-time work. The forms differ, but “sambilan” is also used in both varieties, so the relation is contrastive rather than exclusive. No false-friend issue is present.
